name: rails-safety
description: Local power manifest for Rails safety constraints: state machine row locking, AuditEvent immutability, and ActionExecutor policy verification.

rules.description: All AASM state machine transitions on order records must be preceded by order.lock! to acquire a PostgreSQL row lock.
AuditEvent records are append-only. The model must define before_update and before_destroy callbacks that raise unconditionally.
ActionExecutor must query AuditEvent for an authorization record matching (order_id, recovery_action_id, policy_config_version) and raise PolicyBypassError if none is found.
RecoveryContext must be a deeply frozen Ruby Data object (Data.define on Ruby >= 3.2). No ActiveRecord references or method_missing delegation permitted.
PolicyEngine must be a pure function: no I/O, no DB access, no side effects. Given the same inputs it must always return the same output.
